cells: 4000005 / AMR-039-0005 — Ollivier Problem E: unrestricted nonreversible L2 spectral-radius/operator-norm gap and ordinary local Poincaré subquestions under positive coarse Ricci curvature. Original problem list, printed2: https://www.yann-ollivier.org/rech/publs/problems_curvmarkov.pdf . Broader approximation program not marked solved.

Fu-Zhou Gong, Yuan Liu and Zhi-Ying Wen, Ricci curvature of Markov chains on Polish spaces revisited, Osaka Journal of Mathematics50(2) (2013),491–502, Section3 printed495; credits Fu-Zhou Gong and Li-Ming Wu for the counterexample. Existing full negative answer to the unrestricted spectral-radius/norm and ordinary-local-energy extensions, not closure of all Problem E. The published a=1/2 Bernoulli-prepending example is compact Polish with positive coarse curvature and stationary mean-zero L2 spectral radius1. Direct reconstruction in PR1290 proves the corrected identities PP*=I and P*P=tail conditional expectation, every power norm1, closed unit-disk complex spectrum, strong fixed-vector decay, and failure of ordinary jump, residual, and one-step conditional-variance coercivity. The printed P*P=I is locally reversed under its explicit prepending convention; the published radius-one conclusion remains correct. The chain is topologically irreducible but not measure/Harris irreducible; no such extra hypothesis is in the original general framework. The DOI is the authenticated JaLC/Osaka repository DOI for this published Version of Record, resolving200 to matching title/authors/journal metadata and accessible full PDF. Fresh PDF SHA256d35c6a0a42cf735427b29936b96c8b3a04568ae0b4c106e3735c841b64a4a607 differs from the PR's historical PDF pin; current primary body was independently inspected and corroborated by another repository copy. Finite-truncation gap/strong-approximation calculations are contextual reconstruction, not asserted as printed2013 theorems or a universal approximation impossibility. Reversible/entropic Erbar–Fathi results and blurred-gradient inequalities are unaffected. Existing journal publication, no new project theorem/upload; current review is AI-assisted, not formal independent human peer review. PR reference: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1290 .
